scope_statement: Full tracked Python file inventory at two official commits and native crate inventory at a frozen HMI commit. Inventory counts do not establish semantic parity; no runtime or physical tests were executed by this audit. Current working-tree changes are excluded.
historical_fork_resolution: Connector get_repo returned 404; no absence/deletion conclusion. Pinned commit resolved independently in official repository.

branch_relationships.qualification_rule: Source ancestry does not transport test results to a changed tree. Divergent branch evidence is not pooled.

evidence_levels.source_review: selected implementation contract and consumer reviewed
evidence_levels.offline_fixture: historical source-pinned test reports, not rerun by this audit
evidence_levels.native_engine: native inference/library executed with exact asset provenance; input may be synthetic
evidence_levels.live_owner: authenticated existing Hepta owner/thread and real effect trace
evidence_levels.physical_device: actual selected hardware path; callback completion alone is not human perception
evidence_levels.production: real owner + permissions + physical/media/network recovery + user-perceived outcome + independent evidence

static_checks: Python AST frame inheritance census with generic bases normalized

native_test_file_scope: native_crates[*].test_files enumerates tracked .rs files under that crate tests/ directory only. Inline or src-hosted unit tests are not separately enumerated. rust_files counts all tracked .rs files in the crate. Neither count establishes runtime coverage or parity.

historical_full_gate.scope: Historical checkpoint reported by the frozen source documentation; not a test execution on this audit or on the current implementation branch.
historical_full_gate.qualification_rule: Earlier full-gate passes and later scoped passes do not clear this recorded failure. Separate current Core tests that do not cover WebRTC are not evidence closing the WebRTC gate.
